The authored factory preserves four shares, the triangulated hitch, hydraulic assembly, and named sockets for development placeholder use, but the real img2threejs blockout remains locked at refine-code: Tier 1 silhouette IoU 0.470 and aspect-ratio delta 0.1001 still fail.

entries.intendedUse: Repo-local developer derivative for validating named part boundaries, sockets, material slots, and customizable rig-part integration.
entries.notes: GLB export is deterministic and structurally preflighted. Runtime manifest admission remains intentionally deferred to the parallel-owned runtime lane; this derivative is not public or hero-production approved because the current img2threejs Tier 1 silhouette gate remains below threshold. The two artifacts ship differently and the manifest states each separately: the authored procedural factory at sourcePath is imported by src/game/renderer.ts and therefore compiles into the player bundle (it stamps userData.assetId, so this id necessarily appears in bundle text), while the GLB at runtimePath is withheld by the vite copy gate and stays absent from dist. publicRuntimeApproved governs the GLB only; sourceFormInPlayerBuild records the source form, and tools/assert-player-build-assets.mjs verifies both independently.
